Appearance:
 Ms. Kusum Sharma - Advocate for applicant.
Shri Saket Naresh Udainiya- Public Prosecutor for resp
Shri Lokendra Sharma- Advocate for complainant.

Order 
This present application has been filed by the applicant under Section 482 of BNSS, 2023 for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant relating to Crime No. 61/2025 registered at Police Station - Pohri, District Shivpuri (M.P.) for the offence under Section 376 of IPC and Section 3/4 of POCSO Act.

2. Learned counsel for the applicant by taking this Court to the prosecution version submits that the FIR has been lodged on 23.02.2025 when the prosecutrix was around 18 years and 04 months old even as per prosecution and the instances of sexual assault are alleged between the period 11.09.2023 to 28.06.2024 and the last instance of sexual assault even as per FIR allegation is eight months prior to lodging of the FIR, which is on 23.02.2025.

It is contended that the dates have been so modified only to NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:11614 2 MCRC-14096-2025 bring the instances during the age of minority of the prosecutrix and further that present applicant is engineering college student studying in second year of B.tech course and is aged around 21 years.
If he is incarcerated in connection with alleged offence, his educational career and future prospects would be adversely effected.

He further undertakes to cooperate in the investigation by presenting himself before the Investigating Officer and the trial Court as and when required to subject himself to medical reports and other examinations as and when required by the Investigating Officer.
3 . Per contra, learned counsel for the complainant as well as learned counsel for State have vehemently opposed the application.
However, the age of the applicant so also absence of any criminal antecedents as against the present applicant are not disputed.

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid, but without commencing anything conclusively on the merits of the case, this Court is inclined to grant the benefit of anticipatory bail to the applicant.

5. Accordingly, this application is allowed and it is directed that in case, if the applicant appears before the Investigating Officer/trial Court within fifteen days from today and furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs. 50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Investigating Officer/trial Court, in the event of arrest, he shall be released on anticipatory bail.

It is made clear that in case if applicant fails to appear before the Investigating Officer/trial Court within the fifteen days from today, then this order shall automatically stand cancelled.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:11614 3 MCRC-14096-2025 6.

The applicant shall further abide by following conditions :-
(1) Applicant shall present himself before the Investigating Officer and shall cooperate in the investigation as well as subjecting himself to medical examination as and when required by the Investigating Officer.

(2) Applicant shall not keep himself in proximity with the prosecutrix or any person of the complainant party or any of the witnesses during investigation and trial, failing which the benefit of anticipatory bail shall liable to be withdrawn.
